name: Every starting XI player has a non-empty name and a valid position
description: When the per-match lineups artifact is fetched, every player in both teams' starting_xi has a non-empty name string and a position drawn from the GK, DEF, MID, FWD vocabulary, so the lineup is real structured data rather than blank slots.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Iterate over every player entry across home.starting_xi and away.starting_xi
Verify every player entry has a name that is a non-empty, non-whitespace string
Verify every player entry has a position equal to one of GK, DEF, MID, or FWD
